title: Living On Dividends -The 3 Bucket Retirement System : How to Build a Retirement Portfolio
description: Living on Dividends: The 3-Bucket Retirement System Retirement changes the job of your money. While you were working, your portfolio had one primary goal: growth. But once the paycheck stops, your investments must begin doing several jobs at the same time—providing income for today, protecting you during difficult markets, and continuing to grow for the years ahead. Living on Dividends: The 3-Bucket Retirement System introduces a simple, practical framework for organizing retirement savings around those three jobs. Inside this easy-to-follow guide, you will learn how to: Calculate your true retirement income gap Build a Foundation Bucket for liquidity and short-term security Create an Income Bucket designed to help produce a reliable retirement paycheck Maintain a Growth Bucket to help fight inflation and support a retirement that could last 20, 25, or even 30 years Understand why total return matters more than simply chasing the highest yield Evaluate dividend and income ETFs by looking at NAV, distributions, strategy, expenses, and tax considerations Create rules for replenishing and rebalancing each bucket Prepare for a 20% or 30% market decline before it happens Use spending guardrails to help protect your portfolio during difficult markets Turn your retirement savings into a coordinated system instead of one large pile of investments The book also walks through practical retirement examples, including how a retiree with a $600,000 portfolio could calculate the amount needed from investments and organize the portfolio around that income requirement. You'll also receive simple worksheets designed to help you calculate your own income gap, determine how much you may want in each bucket, and review your retirement plan each year. description: Retirement Puts You in Charge of What Comes Next. Retirement brings a freedom you may have spent decades wishing for: the freedom to decide what comes next. But when the schedules, responsibilities, and routines of working life disappear, deciding what you want this next chapter to become can be surprisingly difficult. The question is no longer what your job requires, but what matters to you. A Happy and Affordable Retirement offers a practical, personalized way forward. title: The Four Buckets: A Behavior-Proof Approach to Reliable Retirement Income
description: Are you living your ideal retirement or standing in its way? Every day, retirees face a surprising but consistent challenge—and it’s not what most people expect. It’s not about whether they’ve saved enough, or if they’ll run out of money. It’s about what happens next: how to actually enjoy the retirement they’ve worked so hard to create. Too often, retirement becomes a story of caution. Cutting back on spending, saying "no" when you really want to (and can) say "yes," taking income and drawing from accounts only when necessary. The result? A retirement overshadowed by unnecessary fear and missed opportunities. In The Four Buckets , financial planner Ethan Lohr, CFP® invites you to reimagine what retirement can be. This book isn’t about reckless spending or unrealistic dreams—it’s about giving yourself permission to live more fully, backed by a clear, strategic framework that supports the life you want. Through the stories of real retirees just like you, you'll discover the challenges, fears, hopes, and opportunities that come with this new season of life. You'll also learn how those very experiences helped shape the Four Buckets Retirement Income Strategy®—an approach designed to meet not only the financial needs of retirees, but their emotional needs as well. Now in its second generation of serving retirees, the Four Buckets Strategy has been shaped by decades of helping people navigate the transition from saving money to spending it with confidence. Inside, you'll discover how to: Turn your savings into reliable retirement income so you can spend less time worrying about money and more time enjoying life. title: The Buckets of Money Retirement Solution: The Ultimate Guide to Income for Life
description: Investors, shell-shocked by the "Great Recession" of 2008-2009, are looking for answers, for something fresher than the old 'buy-and-hold' mantra. They hunger for stability, yet yearn for growth to rejuvenate their battered portfolios. Ray Lucia's The Buckets of Money Retirement Solution: The Ultimate Guide to Income for Life provides just that—a reassuring and scientifically proven strategy that gives investors both growth and income. Lucia, a Certified Financial Planner who's helped thousands of people invest more than $2 billion, explains how to spend down 'safe' buckets (containing, for example, Treasuries, CDs, bonds), while leaving a riskier bucket (real estate, stocks and alternative investments) to grow long-term. This strategy shields investors from the short-term ups and downs of the market. And it gives them the courage and discipline to stay invested no matter what the future holds. Written in a breezy, accessible style and loaded with tons of examples and clear, specific calculations, the book explains how to set your financial goals, divvy up your money accordingly, and then invest intelligently. With this book as your guide, readers will learn how to achieve both income and growth while at the same time reducing risk. "All in all," Lucia writes, "this plan is akin to a sports car that seats six, approximating the best of both worlds. In this case by being a conservative strategy that’s also growth-oriented." Almost every kind of investment—stocks, bonds, commodities, real estate—plunged in the past year or two, turning off millions of investors who'd been planning for and counting on a reasonably comfortable retirement. title: The Complete Retirement Bucket List: 100+ Adventures Sized to Your Budget, Energy, and Tim
description: "You Earned The Free Time. Now You Need Something To Do With It." It's a Tuesday afternoon. The career is behind you. The calendar is wide open. And the freedom everyone promised feels less like a beach and more like a blank wall. You bought the bucket list book. Maybe two. Maybe three. You read about skydiving and Tuscany, then closed the book and put it on the shelf — because none of it fit. The ideas were vague. Half were things you already do. The rest assumed you had the body of a 40-year-old, a savings account you don't have, or a travel partner who's still here. You don't need more inspiration. You need a system. A bucket list you can actually use, not one that lives on the refrigerator. Every idea in this guide runs through the Three-Tier Filter: budget, energy, and time. You'll know instantly what fits your current life, not the life someone wrote a book for ten years ago. Every item carries a "Done When…" marker, so vague goals like "travel more" become measurable experiences that actually get completed. You'll also write your Reverse Bucket List a gratitude inventory of what you've already lived. Because you didn't arrive at retirement empty-handed. By the final chapter “The Working Planner” you won't be holding a book of ideas. You'll be holding a finished, scheduled bucket list. Inside, you'll discover: The Three-Tier Filter tagging every adventure for budget, energy, and time The "Done When…" rule that turns daydreams into completed experiences The Reverse Bucket List honoring the life you've already lived The Micro-Adventure System 20 small adventures to start this week Honest self-assessment and adaptive adventures for limited mobility Dedicated chapters for solo retirees, the recently widowed, the long-time single, pet owners, introverts, and caregivers
